{{Top|leg}}
A '''dart spitter''' was a device used to fire darts, usually poisoned. Approximately the size of a pack of [[Death stick/Legends|deathsticks]], the spitter was attached to the wearer's hand, with the darts fired through a tube that ran from the device to the tip of the wearer's finger.
